meta.name: prisma-client-api
meta.description: Prisma Client API reference covering model queries, filters, operators, and client methods. Use when writing database queries, using CRUD operations, filtering data, or configuring Prisma Client. Triggers on "prisma query", "findMany", "create", "update", "delete", "$transaction".

copy.tagline: 查询和操作数据库记录
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要经常查询和修改数据库中的数据。
copy.tagline_en: Look up database query patterns with Prisma
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often write database queries and update records.

howto.what: 提供 Prisma Client API 参考，指导编写数据库查询、CRUD 操作、过滤排序、关系处理、事务及原生 SQL 等，产出符合语法的 Prisma 代码示例。
howto.when: 当用户需要编写数据库查询、执行增删改查、过滤数据或配置 Prisma Client 时触发；提到“prisma query”、“findMany”、“$transaction”等关键词也会触发。

say.text: 用 findMany 查询所有管理员用户，按创建时间倒序，只取前10条。
say.note: 会生成对应的 Prisma 查询代码。

say.text: 写一个创建用户并同时创建其首篇文章的事务。
用 updateMany 批量将过期订单状态改为已取消。

howto.what_en: Provides Prisma Client API reference and guidance for writing database queries, CRUD operations, filtering/sorting, relations, transactions, and raw SQL, producing valid Prisma code examples.
howto.when_en: Triggers when writing database queries, performing CRUD, filtering data, or configuring Prisma Client; also on keywords like "prisma query", "findMany", "$transaction".

say_en.text: Use findMany to get all admin users ordered by creation date desc, limit 10.
Write a transaction to create a user and their first post.
Use updateMany to set expired orders to cancelled.
